title: Repetepetition
identity: Hindson’s Repetepetition is an arrangement for soprano saxophone and piano, 2011, approximately four minutes. The composer’s catalog gives the instrumentation and duration and links a Spotify recording; Faber’s listing dates the arrangement as 2004/2011.

evidence.claim: Opened composer catalog lists Repetepetition under soprano saxophone/piano, 2011, four minutes, with a Spotify link.

Australian Music Centre’s 2024 HSC saxophone repertoire list records Repetepetition for soprano saxophone and piano, 2004 (arr. 2011), 11-page score and 3-page part, three minutes, Advanced difficulty, and lists score and audio samples plus a recording on CD 2385. The list documents HSC repertoire context; audio was not auditioned.
evidence.source_name: Australian Music Centre, 2024 HSC Saxophone Repertoire List

evidence.claim: Visually inspected the Australian Music Centre’s one-page public score sample. It is an arrangement version created for Michael Duke and David Howie. The opening has a fast recurring saxophone figure marked “Tempo up to Presto,” alternating meters including 4/4, 3/4, 7/8, 2/4, 5/8, 3/8 and 5/4 in the excerpt; the piano joins the opening saxophone attack, then rests and later carries chordal material. This is a single-page excerpt, not a full-score survey.
evidence.source_name: Australian Music Centre public score sample, PDF p. 1

score_observations: The one-page sample opens with a recurring, fast saxophone figure marked “Tempo up to Presto,” using slurs and staccato dots. The excerpt moves through several changing meters, including 4/4, 3/4, 7/8, 2/4, 5/8, 3/8 and 5/4. The piano joins the first saxophone attack, then rests and later takes chordal and more active passages. This limited sample does not establish full range or form.
review_focus: Inference from the excerpt: review rapid recurring figures, articulation changes, meter changes, and the saxophone’s rests while the piano enters. The sample is too short to characterize the complete piece.
collection_flag: The Australian Music Centre 2024 HSC Saxophone list classifies the edition as Advanced repertoire for HSC use. This is a school certificate context, not a college-year mapping.

listening.verification: Composer page link resolved to a Spotify embed; audio page returned a cache-miss access failure and was not auditioned.

score_links.description: Australian Music Centre one-page score sample; opening page visually inspected.

gaps: Only a one-page score sample was inspected; full form, written range, and work-wide musical demands remain unknown.
The HSC list gives three minutes while the composer’s page gives an approximate four minutes; the reason for the duration difference is unresolved.
A linked recording is listed, but audio was not auditioned.
